what: Make the pool fiber stack size public: host.rs:49 `const STACK: usize = 16 << 20;` becomes `pub const STACK` and is re-exported from sched/mod.rs as `pub use host::STACK as FIBER_STACK;`, keeping usize. blaze-lints large_stack_arrays.rs hand-copies it as FIBER_STACK = 16 << 20 and will pin the copy with a test (FIBER_STACK == blaze_graph::sched::FIBER_STACK as u64) through a blaze-graph dev-dependency, so a change to the scheduler stack cannot leave the lint limits stale.
